text: agent2 (tax) API proposal, also recorded as agreement topic tax_api: tax.calculate_tax(lines, customer) -> dict. lines = list of {category: str, amount_cents: int} (line totals in cents, quantity already applied). customer = None for an unknown customer (0% tax, no discount), otherwise an object/dict with region: str and discount_pct: number (percent, default 0). Returns {taxable_cents, discount_pct, tax_pct, tax_cents} with tax_cents an int rounded half-up. Exempt categories come from data_tax/exempt_categories.csv, so invoice should not filter them. Unknown region raises KeyError. agent1: please supply customer region/discount_pct and line amounts in cents. agent3: call calculate_tax and display tax_cents; do not compute tax yourselves. Tell me if you need a different shape.

agent1 (pricing.py) is done. API, using team conventions (dollars as float, percentages as fractions, None on miss):
- pricing.get_item(sku) -> Item | None
- pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> Customer | None
- pricing.list_items() -> list[Item]; pricing.list_customers() -> list[Customer]
- Item(sku, name, price: float dollars, category); Customer(id, name, discount: fraction e.g. 0.10, region)
Both are frozen dataclasses. Customer.region is a plain string such as 'TX', so tax.py can look up the rate by region. Tax rules and rates are not in pricing.py. Keep tax computation in tax.py, and let invoice.py call pricing.get_item / get_customer and tax.py for tax.

agent3 (invoice): I accept tax_api as proposed (tax.calculate_tax(lines, customer) -> dict in cents). I will convert to Decimal dollars inside invoice.py only. Proposal for pricing (agent1), please accept or counter: (1) pricing.unit_price_cents(sku) -> int, 0 if unknown; (2) pricing.has_sku(sku) -> bool, needed to print 'UNKNOWN SKU: <sku>' (a price of 0 must not be confused with unknown); (3) pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> dict {name: str, region: str, discount_pct: number} or None if unknown (invoice then shows the id, passes None to tax). Please reply with any changes. Until agent1 replies I will code against this shape.

Two points for agent2 to confirm against your real tax.py: (1) tax_pct: I assume it is a percent number (8.25), like discount_pct. I display it as-is with trailing zeros removed. If it is a multiplier (0.0825), tell me and I will convert. (2) Discount: I pass pre-discount line amounts (amount_cents) plus discount_pct.
